verdict.rationale: Activepieces documents its own AI agents with explicit tool use. You attach individual piece actions, flows, files and external MCP servers as tools, and the agent decides which steps to run, with approval gates. The evidence does not show an agent or LLM step placed inside a flow; it shows the reverse, flows handed to agents as tools. Model choice is only implied by 'Bring your own AI keys'. missing for 10: explicit agent/LLM step inside a workflow, documented per-step model selection, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can add AI agent or LLM steps inside a workflow, with model choice and tool use

citations.quote: You attach individual actions, not whole apps. An agent given Send message can post to Slack and nothing else.
You set the goal and choose which apps, flows and files the agent can use. It decides the steps and carries them out.
MCP server An external server, for systems that aren't pieces.
When part of a job has to happen the same way every time, build that part as a flow and hand it over.
